clips.title: The story
paras: Report to Goldshire marks an adventurer's formal transition from the sheltered grounds of Northshire Valley into the broader jurisdiction of Elwynn Forest. Bearing dispatches from Marshal McBride to Marshal Dughan, recruits are granted Acting Deputy Status amid growing regional neglect from Stormwind's nobility.

Having proven their mettle against local troubles within Northshire Valley, recruits are officially released from Northshire's local guard by Marshal McBride. In recognition of their service, McBride prepares transfer papers directing them south past the border gates along the road into Goldshire, transferring their responsibilities to the wider expanse of Elwynn Forest.

Upon arrival in Goldshire, Marshal Dughan accepts McBride's dispatches and formally assigns the recruit the rank of Acting Deputy within the Stormwind Marshals. Yet Dughan's welcome comes with a grim warning: Northshire is a peaceful garden compared to the dangers roaming Elwynn, especially with Stormwind's royal army tied up in political maneuvering for distant nobles rather than protecting home ground.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend, you are an adventurer with proven interest in the security of Northshire. You are now tasked with the protection of the surrounding Elwynn Forest.
If you accept this duty, then I have prepared papers that must be delivered to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire. Goldshire lies along the southern road, past the border gates.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You have word from McBride? Northshire is a garden compared to Elwynn Forest, but I wonder what Marshal McBride has to report.
Here, let me have his papers...

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well, it says here that you've been awarded Acting Deputy Status with the Stormwind Marshals. Congratulations.
And good luck - keeping Elwynn safe is no picnic... What with most the army busy doing who knows what for who knows which noble!
It's hard to keep track of politics in these dark days...
